A1_delete_failed_experiment.defense: Experiment deletion is not allowed in branch registry
A1_delete_failed_experiment.detail: Registry schema requires experiment ledger; deletion violates integrity

A2_expand_budget_after_results.attack: Expand experiment budget after favorable results
A2_expand_budget_after_results.defense: Budget changes require documented justification before execution
A2_expand_budget_after_results.detail: Budget is locked at branch creation; expansion requires formal review

A3_run_without_preregistration.defense: Confirmatory mode requires registration digest in experiment spec
A3_run_without_preregistration.detail: Experiment spec schema requires preregistration_digest for CONFIRMATORY mode

A4_modify_registration_after_execution.defense: Registration is_locked flag prevents modification; modification invalidates registration
A4_modify_registration_after_execution.detail: Confirmatory policy requires locked registration before execution

A5_change_hypothesis_after_results.defense: Hypothesis statement is part of locked registration; change requires new hypothesis ID
A5_change_hypothesis_after_results.detail: Hypothesis schema requires unique ID; statement changes create new hypothesis

A6_hide_pit_classification.defense: PIT classification is required field in data spec; UNKNOWN is explicit classification
A6_hide_pit_classification.detail: Data governance policy requires PIT classification for all datasets

A7_treat_revised_as_strict_pit.defense: PIT classification determines allowed conclusion strength
A7_treat_revised_as_strict_pit.detail: Conclusion strength by PIT classification enforces appropriate restrictions

A8_promote_weak_result.attack: Promote statistically interesting but economically weak result
A8_promote_weak_result.defense: Promotion ladder requires economic materiality threshold
A8_promote_weak_result.detail: Hypothesis schema requires economic_materiality_threshold; promotion policy requires meeting it

A9_promote_universe_dependent_as_robust.attack: Promote a universe-dependent result as robust
A9_promote_universe_dependent_as_robust.defense: Promotion requires universe consistency; conflict resolution classifies as UNIVERSE_DEPENDENT
A9_promote_universe_dependent_as_robust.detail: Conflict resolution policy requires universe consistency for ROBUST classification

A10_reuse_invalid_phase13b_metrics.defense: Legacy evidence migration marks Phase 13B as HISTORICAL_ONLY with documented defect
A10_reuse_invalid_phase13b_metrics.detail: Legacy inventory documents purge defect; metrics marked invalid

A11_duplicate_hypothesis.attack: Duplicate a hypothesis under a new ID
A11_duplicate_hypothesis.defense: Hypothesis schema requires unique statement + mechanism combination; duplicate detection required
A11_duplicate_hypothesis.detail: Branch registry tracks hypothesis family; duplicates detected

A12_skip_evidence_review.defense: Evidence review is required stage in promotion ladder; cannot skip stages
A12_skip_evidence_review.detail: Promotion policy requires evidence review before confirmatory advancement

A13_replace_historical_result.attack: Replace a historical result without provenance
A13_replace_historical_result.defense: Historical artifacts are immutable; modification requires new artifact with provenance
A13_replace_historical_result.detail: ORBIT's immutable artifact system prevents silent modification

A14_degenerate_model_as_confirmation.attack: Allow degenerate model to count as model-family confirmation
A14_degenerate_model_as_confirmation.defense: Model governance requires degenerate model detection; degenerate models flagged
A14_degenerate_model_as_confirmation.detail: Model governance policy requires automatic degenerate model detection

A15_experiments_outside_scope.defense: Branch scope is defined at creation; out-of-scope experiments require new branch
A15_experiments_outside_scope.detail: Exploratory policy requires explicit allowed datasets/universes/horizons

A16_average_conflicting_signs.attack: Average conflicting signs into false robustness
A16_average_conflicting_signs.defense: Conflict resolution policy requires separate reporting; averaging conflicting signs is prohibited
A16_average_conflicting_signs.detail: Conflict resolution policy classifies as FRAGILE or CONTEXT_DEPENDENT
